notes.title: IT Specialist Simulator Release Coming!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! 👋[/p][p][/p][h3]We’re excited to share a big update: [i]IT Specialist Simulator[/i] will officially launch on [b]November 20[/b]! 🚀[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="eZWP6taaP8k;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Over the past months, we’ve been hard at work polishing the game, listening to your feedback, and adding those final touches to make sure the simulator feels as authentic and engaging as possible.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s a quick look at what we’ve been focusing on recently:[/p][h3]🔧 [b]Gameplay Polish[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Refined repair & troubleshooting mechanics to feel more intuitive.[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded the range of IT problems you’ll face — from hardware failures to tricky software bugs.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🖥️ [b]Career Progression[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved career mode that lets you grow from junior IT support to a full-on tech expert.[/p][/*][*][p]New tasks and contracts that keep each playthrough fresh and challenging.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎨 [b]Visual & Performance Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Cleaner UI for better workflow.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized performance so the game runs smoothly across different setups.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]🗓️ [b]What’s Next[/b][/h3][p]Between now and launch, we’ll continue squashing bugs, testing balance, and preparing some fun content to share with you (keep an eye on our social media 👀).[/p][p]We can’t wait for you to dive into the world of IT troubleshooting, upgrading, and problem-solving when the game drops on [b]November 20[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]If you still haven't done it, you can wishlist the game here:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3266090/IT_Specialist_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for all your support — this project wouldn’t be possible without you. 💙[/p][p]Stay tuned,
[i]The IT Specialist Simulator Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.notes: [p]We’re slowly going through the survey responses — if you filled it out, we’ve definitely seen your feedback. We’ve fixed a few things in the demo to make it easier to, for example, find the correct computer.[/p][p]A few people mentioned vision issues, which made reading emails difficult — we took that into account. You were annoyed by Jobbly notifications — we took that into account, too.[/p][p]From now on, in the email app you can:[/p][p]- Change the font size → applies to the email body only[/p][p]- Change the font style → applies to the email body only[/p][p]- Disable notification sounds[/p][p]- Disable notifications for categories: general, jobbly, spam (disabled by default)[/p][p]Fixes:[/p][p]- Email counters now update properly after sending an email, as long as the app is open[/p][p]- The email list now updates when a new email arrives[/p][p]Terminal (cmd):[/p][p]- We’ve added the bcdedit command with the following arguments:[/p][p]  - bcdedit /enum[/p][p]  - bcdedit /enum all[/p][p]  - help bcdedit[/p][p]  - bcdedit default[/p][p]  - bcdedit /timeout[/p][p]  - bcdedit find — here we made a small change compared to the original; normally it should be bcdedit | find[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/7e31ecb58dc005f85bd526bfb078a4e695878d35.png"][/img][/p][p]Added:[/p][p]- We've extended the general level gameplay time to approximately 45 minutes,[/p][p]- Added the option to disable email notification sounds — available in the email settings,[/p][p]- Added a new informational email during gameplay,[/p][p]- Added a new forum thread type — Networks — currently there's only one thread there,[/p][p]- Added a new slide to the tutorial on the general level,[/p][p]- Added a new TV channel to the intro,[/p][p]- Added sound effects to the intro,[/p][p]- Added the ability to open network card properties via double-click[/p][p]- Added new information about employees on map[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed:[/p][p]- Fixed several minor typos,[/p][p]- Reduced the volume of sound effects,[/p][p]- Fixed a bug related to the network card where the player couldn't click the "Properties" button,[/p][p]- Improved the display of the network card window – the blue highlight now disappears when clicking anywhere outside[/p][p][/p][p]We're actively reviewing and analyzing every comment on Steam and YouTube. We're also reading through the surveys you're filling out — thank you! ❤️  However, we’d like to clarify a few things:[/p][p][/p][p]- We will not be adding mechanics related to eating and sleeping on the general level,[/p][p]- The Early Access release will include only the general level (and possibly the first specialization branch),[/p][p]- The general level will have its own tutorial, similar to the one in the intro,[/p][p]- The general level will gain a second floor — currently under renovation 😅,[/p][p]- Computers, network devices, and other equipment will gain many new features,[/p][p][/p][p]We're planning around 250–350 different tasks for the Early Access release 😅[/p]

notes.title: Game Update - February
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello! [/h1]

It's been a while since the last update, so we want to show you what we've managed to do over the next month. We've made a few minor changes to the player interface, but thanks to that the interface is more user-friendly. We've also been creating a system for saving the game for a long time. It was quite a difficult task due to the various mechanics in the game.

[h2]Tablet[/h2]

The first thing that might catch your eye is the tablet. We've added it and are introducing the first applications there. The tablet itself will play a significant role in the game and will be a great convenience for the player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/b1d0ac31a364ec3e87244db7ec5429df84eaac3f.gif[/img]

[h2]Fasko - OneConnect (VPN)[/h2]

Until now, to connect to VPN, all you had to do was have Internet access and click the Connect button. Thanks to the tablet, we could add a special application for 2-step verification. Thanks to this, we made this process more realistic. To start VPN, we have to enter the numbers that are displayed on the monitor into the application on the tablet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/14a2a3f9b81250d44e5a6b17330caaadce8e7d00.gif[/img]

[h2]Settings[/h2]

We've added a few new settings, a few aesthetic ones, like the screen saver, a few of which change how the computer works. We've also changed the wallpapers available on the computer and fixed a few bugs related to them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/059f41f318648c4594d50fa0bf12cab0a0dcd0f0.gif[/img]

[h2]Changes in the terminal[/h2]

We have supplemented the ipconfig command and added the ability to ping other devices with the [b]-t[/b] or [b]-T[/b] parameter

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/56397bd4c76444e830ab28db1b3a9e683f1aab52.gif[/img]

[h2]File and folder properties[/h2]

From now on, you can check the properties of a given file or folder. They have several important parameters, such as file size, which is calculated based on the content. The more we write in the file, the longer it will take to download from the network, send on the network, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/f7d3fad8f569a49a1848c206bc2728d379271e87.gif[/img]

[h2]Flash drives and disks[/h2]

We have made every effort to ensure that everything works properly. From now on, each time you connect a new device to the computer, it will be given an appropriate icon and alphabetical letter. From now on, we can boot the flash drive for system installation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/3d6f7d7b9d8bd22a096b452a17329a298b957af4.gif[/img]

[h2]Hamster Application[/h2]

The application will be used to boot pendrives and disks. In the application we can choose which pendrive we want to boot, choose the appropriate iso file with the system and a few smaller functions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/fb5a3a12cd6a456f1bccd80e5ca7da4aed93ee65.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/95291a3c8fb8e3ebfc2aace863b632d0a1f23fa0.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/a196ea4bf4d9a62a8da3a79f4d7c7c91c576f693.gif[/img]

[h2]Web - Jobbly [/h2]

We have also completed the ability to apply for every job you can find on the site Jobbly in the game. There are also more offers related to IT and the further course of the game. Each job offer returns two emails. The first email is automatic and informs about the acceptance of the CV by the company. The second email is an email regarding the status.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/bb2c76797ea132ae598b0a4a645fc3cfd20e2325.gif[/img]

[h2]Router[/h2]

We have added several options in the Router configuration. As we mentioned before. At a general level, the configuration of both the router and the switch will be graphical. If the player wants to follow the appropriate career path, they will configure these devices via the console. Currently, we have added the option of assigning network addressing to a specific port. Thanks to this procedure, if the player wants to change the switch addressing, they must do it via the router. Additionally, you can enable and disable a specific port on the router, thanks to which we will block a certain part of the network.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/83b18f9807473a727631f58f9ad7838fa3c675a2.gif[/img]

[h2]Switch[/h2]

You can access each switch by entering the IP address in the browser. We can change several parameters, check the list of currently connected devices via DHCP, edit which IP address to which DHCP should extend. Additionally, we can check what is connected to each port on the switch. If we change the DHCP range, devices with DHCP enabled will automatically receive a new address if their current address is outside the pool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/4a6d73d8fe5d7bde4e647be71be48fe1f0239efa.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/33d06447521f67523a9892e76333091f912bd587.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/0297a72c640e84a98e77daf303fcece2bd9a6b68.gif[/img]

[h2]BIOS[/h2]

We've fixed a few logic errors related to the BIOS. We have also added a few blue screens related to e.g. damaged VRAM. We have added an option to restore settings to factory settings and an option to exit BIOS without saving. and changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/e7d8ba14920eb3a2b604c8e816698c3f420bc6ed.gif[/img]

[h2]RCP - work registration reader[/h2]

We have added a few smaller functionalities, such as: settings, restarting the device, turning off the device if it is only in the RACK cabinet. For now, we do not want to reveal full information about this device.

[h2]Cats[/h2]

Yes, exactly. We have added cats to the game. One of the users of a certain platform wrote that the game must have cats! So, we listened to one of you and added a few cats. For this purpose, we also created a place for them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45240152/089c5ba487ee6ff0a10c0f5ae25d9e7f05fce603.gif[/img]

We've added a few new features, but we don't want to reveal them at this time! See you soon!

P.S. Will someone fix our network? :P
